findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.citation_text:
4-303.11 At the start of the inspection, there were no sanitizer buckets or spray bottles available. During the inspection, a sanitizer spray bottle of bleach was created and tested at 100ppm. Ensure that a sanitizer solution is readily available during all hours of operation. 
4-303.11: (A) Cleaning agents that are used to clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-6, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation. 
(B) Except for those that are generated on-site at the time of use, chemical SANITIZERS that are used to sanitize EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-7, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: The microwave is missing its turn plate. Ensure a replacement plate is acquired and used or that a replacement microwave is purchased and utilized. 
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The drawers in the kitchen were observed visibly soiled in contact with the food contact surfaces of equipment. The items from the drawers were removed from service, wash, rinsed, and sanitized, and the drawers were cleaned and sanitized during the inspection. Ensure food contact surfaces remain clean to sight and touch.
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.comment: Bleach that is being used in the three compartment sink is a lemon scented bleach. This is not approved for use in food service. Use only non-scented, plain bleach that has both an EPA Registration number and instructions for use on food contact surfaces on the label. Prepare according to the label requirements. Provide an approved sanitizer as discussed. 7-204.11  (P) Chemical sanitizers must meet the requirements specified in 40 CFR 180.940, or meet the requirements as specified in 40 CFR 180.2020. Reference 7-204.11.

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment: Observed boxes of toilet paper stored on the floor in the mop sink room. All single service items must be stored at least 6 inches off of the floor.
findings.citation_text: 4-903.11(A) and (C)  (C) Single-Use Articles shall be stored: 1) in a clean and dry location; 2) away or protected from contamination; 3) at least six inches above the floor; 4) covered or inverted. Reference 4-903.11(A) and (C).
